content.text:
The import job finished with status "succeeded". It read all 9 files and loaded 11 records, but 3 files were in formats it can't read. This did not connect your API account.

**API connection:** Neither Google nor Fitbit is connected. Both show no token. A Takeout import works without the API and doesn't create a connection. Fitbit's legacy Web API is scheduled to shut off on 2026-10-30. Google isn't set up here either, because no ghealth CLI credentials were found. Connecting would be a separate step, and I haven't done it.

**What was imported:** It's a very small dataset, with data on only a few days.

| Source | Data | Date |
|---|---|---|
| Fitbit Takeout | Steps (2 records) | 2026-10-01 |
| Fitbit Takeout | Heart rate (1 record) | 2026-10-01 |
| Fitbit Takeout | Resting heart rate (1 record) | 2026-10-01 |
| Fitbit Takeout | BMI (1 record) | 2026-10-01 |
| Fitbit Takeout | Weight (1 record) | 2026-10-01 |
| Fitbit Takeout | Sleep: efficiency, minutes asleep, minutes awake, time in bed (1 session) | 2026-10-02 |
| Google Takeout | Steps (1 record) | 2026-10-03 |

**Limitations:**
- **Weight:** Its unit is unknown, so it's left out of unit-converted summaries.
- **Resting heart rate:** One day in that file had no estimate and was treated as missing, not as zero.
- **Unreadable files:** These were skipped.
  - A symbolic link, which wasn't extracted.
  - A sleep-score CSV (`sleep_log_entry_id, timestamp, overall_score`).
  - An `.html` file.
  - A JSON file with an unrecognized structure (`unknownThing`).
  - The skipped files are still on disk in the extracted folder.
- **Missing categories:** There are no records for exercise, nutrition, SpO2, breathing, temperature, ECG, cardio fitness, or any other category not listed above. Absence from this archive doesn't mean you have no such data.

If you want, I can help connect the API account to fill in more history.
